body.subject: Verification correction under the root's ruling: the seat's changed paths select no test file, so the endorsed run is GREEN and no full suite is needed

items.change: The root's ruling of 2026-09-25T06:58Z supersedes the verification posture in contribution-70220f87e5e853dfff84e562dc2a766c: no seat is to run the canonical suite, and a change is verified with node impl/scripts/run-suite.mjs --changed <changed paths>, reading its failures, then landed with swarm integrate, which re-runs the failing files on the target and blocks only on failures the target does not share. This seat holds no full-suite run in progress and started none after the ruling.
items.evidence: baton test runner: --changed selected 0 test file(s) from 3 changed path(s) — 3 changed path(s) affect no test file; baton suite verdict (SUBSET 0 of 737 files): GREEN — 0 passed, 0 failed, 0 hung; exit 0, 13 s. This agrees with both landing receipts, whose gates read 'skipped — no_affected_tests'.

items.change: The close-out's deployment-verification item is restated under the ruling: the full-suite run it reports was the deployment's command, not this swarm's acceptance, and it is red on the target by design. Nothing in it is a claim against either landing. The verifications that stand for this seat's work are the changed-path run above, node bend2/scripts/run-checks.mjs green at the landed tip, and laws-check.py 24 rows 0 failed at 26238c65, f3c54b20 and c238cece.

carriedForward: No full-suite run is in progress from this seat and none will be started; the second run this seat had launched before the ruling was killed, and the first had already finished.
The two landings on bend2-rewrite stand unchanged: 8cdc7c4e (contribution-f09c0fc8) and c238cece (contribution-5d23c1cd), both docs-only with no_affected_tests.
A docs-only change selects no test file through the import graph, so the endorsed run for docs work is instant; a seat landing docs need not wait on the suite at all.
needsFromOthers: Root: recorded for the fix the root is preparing — the deployment's verification command should compare against the target the way swarm integrate does, so a seat is never asked to make the canonical suite exit 0.
